plugins.description: LaTeX editor for AI agents: live PDF preview, PDF comments that become edit instructions, a Visual (WYSIWYG) mode, and git-tracked history. Commands: /magic-latex, /ai-review, /address-comments, /ultra-agents, plus one per MCP tool.
